title: Intratumoral heterogeneity: Biological basis, clinical impact and the emerging theory of tumor plasticity (Review).
snippet: Intratumoral heterogeneity (ITH) is a central feature of cancer biology and a major obstacle to effective long-term treatment; it encompasses the presence of diverse cellular subpopulations within a single tumor or across metastatic sites, differing at the genetic, epigenetic, transcriptional, metabolic and phenotypic levels.
